lines.en: label beachvacation15:
scene confession1
: Hey! Sorry I’m late!
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉我迟到了！

lines.en: : I had to tag along to the convenience store with Tsuneyo so she wouldn’t get lost.
lines.zh: : 我得陪常世一起去便利店，免得她走丢。

lines.en: : Do you want a drink? I brought a few back with me.
lines.zh: : 你要喝的吗？我带了几瓶回来。

lines.en: : Oh, no I’m fine! And it’s totally cool.
lines.zh: : 哦，不用了，我没事！完全没关系。

lines.en: : I...I wasn’t really waiting long anyway.
lines.zh: : 我……我也没等多久。

lines.en: : Oh, good! I'm glad to hear that.
lines.zh: : 哦，那就好！听你这么说我就放心了。

lines.en: : So, what’s on the agenda for tonight?
lines.zh: : 那么，今晚有什么安排？

lines.en: : Wanna go for a swim or something?
lines.zh: : 要去游个泳什么的吗？

lines.en: scene confession2
: I’m actually kind of horrible at swimming, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我其实挺不会游泳的。

lines.en: : This one time, when I was little, my foster mom threw me into the pool in one of those like, “Trial by fire” sort of things where you’re supposed to learn how to swim out of fear or...
lines.zh: : 有这么一次，我小时候，我的养母一把把我扔进池子里，就是那种「试炼」之类的，说是让你因为恐惧而学会游泳，或者……

lines.en: : Self-preservation or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 自我保护什么的。我也不知道。

lines.en: scene confession3
: But it like, totally messed me up and now swimming gives me anxiety and oh my God I need to stop talking.
lines.zh: : 可那把我彻底搞坏了，现在一游泳我就焦虑，天哪我得闭嘴了。

lines.en: : Hahahah! It’s fine!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！没关系啦！

lines.en: : I had no idea you were a foster kid.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你是被领养的。

lines.en: : That’s like, another super big surprise about you.
lines.zh: : 这又是关于你的一个超级大惊喜。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t really bring it up much. I probably would have wound up exactly the same even without them soooo yeah.
lines.zh: : 是，我不怎么提这事。而且就算没有他们，我大概也会长成现在这个样子，所以……嗯。

lines.en: scene confession4
: Any reason you decided to tell me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么决定告诉我？

lines.en: : Just...slipped out I guess...
lines.zh: : 就是……不小心说漏嘴了吧……

lines.en: : I’m kind of nervous so like...I might say a bunch of stuff that’s totally weird or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我有点紧张，所以大概会说一大堆很怪的话什么的。

lines.en: : You can just ignore all of that.
lines.zh: : 那些你都可以忽略。

lines.en: : In fact, please ignore all of that.
lines.zh: : 事实上，请务必忽略。

lines.en: scene confession5
: Why would you be nervous? No one else is even around right now.
lines.zh: : 你为什么会紧张？现在周围又没有别人。

lines.en: scene confession6
: That’s exactly what the problem is...
lines.zh: : 问题恰恰就在这儿……

lines.en: scene confession5
: If I give off one of those...intimidating auras or whatever, just let me know.
lines.zh: : 要是我散发出那种……让人有压迫感的气场什么的，你就跟我说。

lines.en: : I also talk like, way more than I’m supposed to a lot of the time and...well, I don’t know if I have any crazy reveals like being a foster child-
lines.zh: : 而且我也老是说得比该说的多得多，还有……嗯，我不知道自己有没有什么像「被领养」那么劲爆的内幕——

lines.en: : But you can also ignore any of the weird stuff I say if that makes you feel a little more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 不过要是我说了什么怪话，让你觉得自在点，你也可以忽略。

lines.en: : Thanks. I’m sure that my stuff will be like, a lot more embarrassing, but that does help a little. I think. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我敢说我的事肯定要尴尬得多，不过这确实有点帮助。大概吧。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Hahaha~!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈~！

lines.en: : Hey, can we sit down?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们能坐下吗？

lines.en: : My legs are kinda tired from the walk and we’re standing like, weirdly far apart right now.
lines.zh: : 走过来我腿有点酸，而且我们现在站得离得也太远了。

lines.en: scene confession7
: Oh, yeah! Totally! I like, really hate standing anyway...Yeah, sitting is good. We can sit.
lines.zh: : 哦，对！当然！我本来就超讨厌站着……嗯，坐着好。我们可以坐。

lines.en: scene nightsky
Have you ever fallen in love?
lines.zh: 你曾经坠入爱河过吗？

lines.en: If so, I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 如果有，那我很抱歉。

lines.en: Love is the only sickness that is socially acceptable to go out of your way to contract.
lines.zh: 爱是唯一一种「人们会主动去感染」却被社会接受的疾病。

lines.en: It makes your mind run wild, your heart beat faster, and can even drive you to the point of insanity under the right set of circumstances.
lines.zh: 它让你思绪狂奔、心跳加速，在合适的条件下甚至能把你逼到发疯。

lines.en: Yet still, we yearn for it.
lines.zh: 可我们依然渴望它。

lines.en: Humans are such confusing creatures, aren’t they?
lines.zh: 人类真是令人费解的生物，不是吗？

lines.en: Striving to be hurt. Living out their lives with only that in mind.
lines.zh: 努力去受伤。一辈子只为此而活。

lines.en: And some die miserable if they were never able to hurt as much as others.
lines.zh: 有些人要是没能像别人那样痛过，还会抱憾而终。

lines.en: None of it makes sense.
lines.zh: 这一切都说不通。

lines.en: scene confession8
Yet still, we yearn for it.
lines.zh: 可我们依然渴望它。

lines.en: Who is it that will get hurt tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚会受伤的是谁呢？

lines.en: : Umm...Hi.
: Hahah~ Hey!
lines.zh: : 哈哈~嗨！

lines.en: : What’s up? Come here often?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : First time this year, I think. You?
lines.zh: : 我想今年是第一次。你呢？

lines.en: : Fourth...fifth time this year, I guess?
lines.zh: : 第四……第五次了吧，今年？

lines.en: : I come with my sister and Yumi every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我偶尔会和我妹妹还有由美一起来。

lines.en: : Even ran into Sensei on the way here a few months ago or-
lines.zh: : 几个月前还在来的路上碰到过老师，还是——

lines.en: scene confession9
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : When...was that?...
lines.zh: : 那……是什么时候的事？……

lines.en: : S-Sister?...
: I didn’t realize you had any siblings.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你有兄弟姐妹。

lines.en: scene confession8
: Just sibling. Singular.
lines.zh: : 只有妹妹。一个。

lines.en: : Older or younger?
lines.zh: : 姐姐还是妹妹？

lines.en: : Younger. She’s like a mini version of me.
lines.zh: : 妹妹。就像迷你版的我。

lines.en: scene confession10
: A mini-Chika?!
lines.zh: : 迷你千佳？！

lines.en: : Hahaha, yup~ She’s like, totally adorable.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈，对啊~她超级可爱的。

lines.en: : You wanna meet her sometime?
lines.zh: : 你想哪天见见她吗？

lines.en: : Yes! Yes! Yes! Please!
lines.zh: : 想！想！想！拜托了！

lines.en: scene confession11
: Wow, I had no idea you liked kids so much.
lines.zh: : 哇，我不知道你这么喜欢小孩。

lines.en: : I don’t! Normally! I think they’re horrible! But this one sounds nice!
lines.zh: : 我平时不喜欢！我觉得他们很讨厌！不过这个听起来不错！

lines.en: : And if she’s anything like her sister, I bet she’ll grow up to be an awesome, totally wonderful girl some day.
lines.zh: : 而且要是她跟她姐姐有半点像，我敢说她长大以后一定会是个超棒、超级好的女生。

lines.en: scene confession12
: Yeah...
: I really hope so.
lines.zh: : 我真希望如此。

lines.en: : I get worried about her pretty often but...she’s in good hands.
lines.zh: : 我经常为她担心，不过……她被照顾得很好。

lines.en: : Well, mostly-good hands. Yumi’s surprisingly gentle with her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也算照顾得不错。由美对她意外地温柔。

lines.en: : In fact, sometimes I feel like Chinami is the only person out there who’s able to get the real Yumi to come out.
lines.zh: : 事实上，有时候我觉得千奈美是这世上唯一能让真正的由美露出来的人。

lines.en: scene confession13
: Sounds like you guys are really close.
lines.zh: : 听起来你们关系真好。

lines.en: : You mean me and Yumi? Or me and my sister?
lines.zh: : 你是说我和由美？还是我和我妹妹？

lines.en: : All three. Like a little family.
lines.zh: : 你们三个。像个小家庭。

lines.en: : Hahah~ I guess we are sort of like a family. Yumi’s definitely the dad, though.
lines.zh: : 哈哈~我们确实有点像一家人。不过由美绝对是那个爸爸。

lines.en: : I can see that. I bet you’d make a good mom, too.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。我打赌你也会是个好妈妈。

lines.en: : I hope so.
lines.zh: : 希望如此吧。

lines.en: : You know about my mom, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我妈妈的事吧？

lines.en: scene confession14
: Y-Yeah...It happened when we were in middle[school]. I even remember what I was wearing that day.
lines.zh: : 嗯……知道……那是我们上初中[school]时的事。我甚至记得那天我穿了什么。

lines.en: : I mean, it was on a Wednesday, so it was my[school] uniform. But still. I remember.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，那天是周三，所以穿的是[school]校服。不过还是。我记得。

lines.en: : I’m sorry if that sounded insensitive. I make jokes when I get uncomfortable sometimes and-
lines.zh: : 要是这话听起来很没分寸，我道歉。我有时候一不自在就会开玩笑，而且——

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’m not upset.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我没有生气。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna lie, it was really hard when she died. But it sort of forced me to step up and take on the role myself.
lines.zh: : 说实话，她去世那阵子真的很难熬。不过那也逼着我站出来，自己担起了那个角色。

lines.en: : So hearing you say I’d make a good mom makes me really happy. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 所以听到你说我会是个好妈妈，我真的很开心。谢谢你。

lines.en: scene confession13
: You don’t have to thank me. I’m just telling the truth.
lines.zh: : 你不用谢我。我只是在说实话。

lines.en: : I think you’d make a pretty good mom, too, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也会是个很好的妈妈，凛。

lines.en: scene confession15
: Okay, now you’re just messing with me.
lines.zh: : 好了，你现在就是在拿我寻开心了。

lines.en: : No, no, no! That’s not it at all!
lines.zh: : 不不不！完全不是那个意思！

lines.en: : Whenever I’m around you, I just feel like you have all of this love to give and no one to really give it to. You know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 每次和你在一起，我都觉得你心里装着满满的爱，却没有可以给它的人。你懂我意思吗？

lines.en: : Yup. That pretty much hits the nail on the head.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你说得一点没错。

lines.en: scene confession16
: But hey, if you’re ever looking to babysit, Chinami could always use some more company!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，你要是哪天想找人帮忙带孩子，千奈美随时都欢迎多点人陪！

lines.en: : I can’t really pay you or anything, but you’d have someone to give all of that love to.
lines.zh: : 我付不起你工钱什么的，不过你就有地方倾注那份爱了。

lines.en: : You’d let me babysit your sister even though I’ve never met her before?
lines.zh: : 你愿意让我帮你带妹妹？我连见都没见过她啊？

lines.en: : What if she doesn’t like me?
lines.zh: : 万一她不喜欢我呢？

lines.en: scene confession17
: There isn’t a single person in this world who wouldn’t like you, Rin.
lines.zh: : 这世上没有一个人会不喜欢你的，凛。

lines.en: : You’re smart...you’re funny...you’re creative...
lines.zh: : 你聪明……你有趣……你有创造力……

lines.en: : You’re a whole bunch of stuff I’ve been chasing after since I was little. And I admire that you seem to be all of those things without really trying.
lines.zh: : 你拥有好多我从小就一直在追逐的东西。而且我佩服你，你似乎毫不费力就能拥有这一切。

lines.en: scene confession18
: I might not seem like it, but I’m one of those people who’s always a little too concerned about what everyone else thinks about me.
lines.zh: : 我也许看起来不像，但我是那种总会有点在意别人怎么看我的人。

lines.en: : So I spent a lot of time refining my personality into like, this ideal sort of girl. But I can’t help but feel like that’s not really me at times, you know?
lines.zh: : 所以我花了很多时间，把自己的性格打磨成那种「理想女生」的样子。可有时候我忍不住觉得，那并不是真正的我，你懂吗？

lines.en: : No. I don’t.
lines.zh: : 不。我不懂。

lines.en: scene confession19
: Hm?
: The Chika next to me right now is the same Chika I see in class every day. None of it's fake.
lines.zh: : 现在坐在我身边的这个千佳，和我每天在班上看到的千佳是同一个人。没有一处是假的。

lines.en: : You have genuine thoughts and feelings and even though you say you’re worried about what others think of you, you still go out of your way to include everyone.
lines.zh: : 你有真实的想法和感受，而且就算你说自己在意别人的看法，你还是会特地把每个人都拉进来。

lines.en: : So that would make you brave. Braver than anyone I know.
lines.zh: : 所以那会让你变得勇敢。比我认识的任何人都要勇敢。

lines.en: : A heck of a lot braver than someone like me, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少比像我这样的人勇敢得多。

lines.en: : Hell, before we met up I basically had a mental breakdown and had to go ask Sensei to calm me down.
lines.zh: : 操，我们在见面之前，我基本上精神崩溃了一回，还跑去求老师让我冷静下来。

lines.en: scene confession20
: Wait, hold up. You just hit me with a lot of information all at once.
lines.zh: : 等等，等等。你一下子塞给我太多信息了。

lines.en: : Mental breakdown? Sensei? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 精神崩溃？老师？怎么回事？

lines.en: : A lot.
lines.zh: : 很多事。

lines.en: : A lot is going on.
lines.zh: : 很多事在发生。

lines.en: : A lot is always going on.
lines.zh: : 永远都有很多事在发生。

lines.en: : And not just for me, for everybody.
lines.zh: : 而且不只是我，是所有人。

lines.en: : Which is why I think it’s so crazy how none of it ever gets to you.
lines.zh: : 所以我才觉得，这些事怎么一点都影响不到你，简直不可思议。

lines.en: : That’s not true...Plenty of things get to me.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢……我也会被很多事影响。

lines.en: : I just don’t let them break me because, if they do, it’s not just me that’s going down.
lines.zh: : 我只是不让它们把我击垮，因为一旦我被击垮，倒下的就不只是我一个人了。

lines.en: scene confession21
: I...had to grow up a little faster than a lot of other people because of my circumstances.
lines.zh: : 因为我的处境，我……不得不比很多其他人更早长大一点。

lines.en: : Plus, you might be forgetting that I’m...what, like a whole year older than you?
lines.zh: : 再说了，你大概忘了，我比你……大多少来着，一整岁？

lines.en: : Something like that. Maybe even closer to two.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。也许快两岁了。

lines.en: : You were held back and I was bumped up. That’s pretty much the only reason the two of us ever had any classes together.
lines.zh: : 你留了一级，我被跳了一级。这基本上就是我们两个能同班的原因。

lines.en: scene confession22
: Oh? Are you bragging now?
lines.zh: : 哦？你现在是在炫耀了？

lines.en: : You better watch your tone with me since I’m like, your pseudo-upperclassman or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你最好注意一下跟我说话的语气，我好歹算是你的伪学姊什么的。

lines.en: : Yes, Pseudo-Senpai. I’ll be more careful.
lines.zh: : 是，伪学姊。我会注意的。

lines.en: scene confession23
: Hahah! This is really fun...
lines.zh: : 哈哈！这真的好开心……

lines.en: : I can't really remember the last time I sat and had a solid conversation with an actual girl-friend.
lines.zh: : 我都记不清上一次坐下来跟一个真正的女性朋友好好聊天是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Like, a non-Yumi girl-friend I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，除了由美之外的女性朋友。

lines.en: : The two of us should come here again some time.
lines.zh: : 我们两个以后该再来这里。

lines.en: : I could bring Chinami along. And Yumi would probably come around to you too with a little bit of prodding.
lines.zh: : 我可以把千奈美带来。而且只要稍微推一把，由美大概也会接受你的。

lines.en: : I’m like, super glad you’re so easy to get along with.
lines.zh: : 我超高兴你这么好相处。

lines.en: : Mhm...I’m glad too...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……我也很高兴……

lines.en: : The moon is beautiful again tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚的月色又这么美。

lines.en: : I think we lucked out.
lines.zh: : 我想我们是走运了。

lines.en: : It’s kind of a shame that it’s all coming to an end tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 明天早上这一切就要结束了，有点可惜。

lines.en: : Before we know it, we’ll all be back in[school] and this entire trip will be nothing but a memory.
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，我们就要回[school]了，这整趟旅行也会只剩下一份记忆。

lines.en: : I kind of wish it would last forever.
lines.zh: : 我真希望它能永远持续下去。

lines.en: : Don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不想吗？

lines.en: : I’m in love with you.
lines.zh: : 我爱上你了。

lines.en: scene confession24
: ...What?
: What did you just say?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚说什么？

lines.en: : Don’t make me say it again. It was hard enough just doing it once.
lines.zh: : 别让我再说一遍。光是第一次就已经够难了。

lines.en: Three Two girls in a line on the beach.
lines.zh: 三 两个女孩在海滩上排成一列。

lines.en: One crying. One confused.
lines.zh: 一个在哭。一个茫然。

lines.en: Sometimes, the most beautiful nights are accompanied by the worst of happenings.
lines.zh: 有时候，最美的夜晚总是伴随着最糟的事。

lines.en: scene confession25
: The moon is beautiful again tonight...isn't it?
lines.zh: : 今晚的月色又这么美……不是吗？

lines.en: : It's amazing...
lines.zh: : 真不可思议……

lines.en: : Thanks for agreeing to hang out with me. Even though I probably just ruined the chances of that ever happening again.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你答应和我一起出来。虽然我大概已经把「还有下次」的可能性给毁了。

lines.en: : I told myself I wouldn’t cry but...holy shit, that was hard...
lines.zh: : 我跟自己说好不哭的，可是……操，那太难了……

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
: Like ten times harder than getting up in front of the class and reciting that stupid poem about not being able to help who we fall in love with.
lines.zh: : 比站在全班面前朗诵那首关于「我们没法控制自己爱上谁」的蠢诗还要难上十倍。

lines.en: : But hey...full-circle and all that right? Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿……也算首尾呼应了吧？哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: else:
: Like ten times harder than anything I've ever done before.
lines.zh: : 比我以前做过的任何事都难上十倍。

lines.en: : But hey...life moves on, right?!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿……日子还得过下去，对吧？！

lines.en: scene confession26
: Hah...hahahaha...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈……哈哈哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: Sometimes, the most beautiful nights are accompanied by nothing at all.
lines.zh: 有时候，最美的夜晚什么都没有伴随。

lines.en: Sometimes, you pour your heart out so effectively that it leaves the recipient of its contents utterly speechless.
lines.zh: 有时候，你把心掏得太彻底，反而让收到这份心意的人哑口无言。

lines.en: That or scared.
lines.zh: 也可能是吓到了。

lines.en: Or confused.
lines.zh: 或者困惑。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell on nights like this.
lines.zh: 在这样的夜晚很难说清。

lines.en: And so we cry.
lines.zh: 于是我们哭泣。

lines.en: Because that’s the only thing our bodies know how to do.
lines.zh: 因为那是我们的身体唯一会做的事。

lines.en: Cry. Cry. Cry.
lines.zh: 哭。哭。哭。

lines.en: Cry until your eyes turn red and irritated.
lines.zh: 哭到眼睛红肿发疼。

lines.en: Then wait for the pain to subside and go back to your normal life.
lines.zh: 然后等痛楚退去，回到你正常的生活。

lines.en: : I have no idea what to say.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该说什么。

lines.en: : I...thought we were just friends.
lines.zh: : 我……我以为我们只是朋友。

lines.en: : I had no idea you felt that way...
lines.zh: : 我不知道你是这种感觉……

lines.en: : I know you didn’t. And you don’t have to remember I do.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不知道。你也不必记得我是这种感觉。

lines.en: : Please forget that I said anything.
lines.zh: : 请忘掉我说过的话吧。

lines.en: : I changed my mind and I want to go back to being friends.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了，我想回到朋友的关系。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to avoid me just because I got swept up in the moment and said something stupid like that.
lines.zh: : 我不想就因为我一时冲动说了那么蠢的话，你就开始躲着我。

lines.en: scene confession27
: Wait, hold on a second!
lines.zh: : 等等，等一下！

lines.en: : Who said anything is going to change?
lines.zh: : 谁说事情会有什么改变？

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s...surprising but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，这确实……很意外，不过……

lines.en: : Well, I kind of already told you but...I’m interested in someone at the moment and-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我大概跟你说过了，我……现在对某个人有意思，而且——

lines.en: : And if I’m going to do anything about it then-
lines.zh: : 而如果我要对此做点什么的话——

lines.en: : Please don’t say anymore right now.
lines.zh: : 现在请别再说了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……我只是……

lines.en: : I don’t want to hear about that.
lines.zh: : 我不想听那个。

lines.en: scene confession28
: Okay...yeah...You wouldn’t want to hear that if...what you said is true...
lines.zh: : 好……嗯……如果……你说的是真的，那你确实不会想听……

lines.en: : I just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我不知道。

lines.en: : I’m still kind of in shock right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在还有点没缓过来。

lines.en: scene confession29
: Yeah...I don’t blame you. I said something really dumb.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不怪你。我说了很蠢的话。

lines.en: : Really really really dumb.
lines.zh: : 非常非常非常蠢的话。

lines.en: : I’m just...I’m gonna go take a walk or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我要去走走什么的。

lines.en: : We’ll...yeah. Never mind.
lines.zh: : 我们……嗯。算了。

lines.en: : Just...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 只是……我不知道……

lines.en: : I’ll see you later.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: : I’m sorry again.
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉。

lines.en: : Bye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: scene confession30
scene black
Things end(?) the same way we expect them to.
lines.zh: 事情的结束（？）和我们预想的一样。

lines.en: With one girl crying, and one girl confused.
lines.zh: 一个女孩在哭，一个女孩茫然。

lines.en: The former locks her eyes on the moon as she runs back to the inn.
lines.zh: 前者盯着月亮，跑回了旅馆。

lines.en: And the latter locks her eyes on the water as she, in a moment of role-reversal-
lines.zh: 而后者盯着水面，在一瞬间的角色互换中——

lines.en: Drowns.
lines.zh: 溺了水。

lines.en: Rin’s affection with Chika has been reset to 0!
lines.zh: 凛与千佳的好感度已被重置为 0！

lines.en: Life moves on.
lines.zh: 日子还得过下去。
